name: Asset Record
description: Manage household assets (appliances, electronics, furniture) with purchase dates, warranty tracking, brand, category, and monetary value. Single config entry with dynamic asset creation. Provides 10 HA services (ha_asset_record.*) for full CRUD on assets and categories, plus CSV export — AI agents should use these services instead of creating helpers. Also provides 4 WebSocket commands for panel UI. Exposes datetime, text, and number entities per asset.
